headline: Trading suspension of Winsome Yarns Limited equity shares effective July 31, 2026 pursuant to NCLT-approved share capital reduction
sum: NSE has suspended trading in equity shares of Winsome Yarns Limited effective July 31, 2026, following an NCLT order authorising reduction of the company's share capital.
detail: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) issued a trading suspension notice on 29 July 2026 for Winsome Yarns Limited, effective 31 July 2026, triggered by an NCLT order sanctioning reduction of the company's share capital. The suspension is standard practice during capital restructuring to prevent trading whilst share entitlements and register adjustments are finalised. The reduction likely involved cancellation of paid-up capital or write-down of paid capital, requiring court sanction under the Companies Act.
